title: Ohmni Robot Alternative for Hospitals | VSee AI Robot
summary: Looking for an Ohmni robot alternative? The VSee AI Robot is purpose-built for hospitals, with LiDAR navigation, remote exams, stroke and virtual sitter workflows, and hospital-grade security.
body_markdown:
*Last updated: October 27, 2026*


**The VSee AI Robot is a telehealth robot purpose-built for hospitals.** It drives autonomously to the bedside, lets remote clinicians do physical exams, meets healthcare IT requirements, and is ready to support your hospital programs on day one — from tele-stroke to virtual sitter to tele-rounding, whether you’re replacing an Ohmni robot or starting a new robot program.

## **1. Purpose-built for hospitals**


While both the Ohmni robot and the VSee AI Robot are designed for healthcare, the VSee robot goes beyond bringing video calls to the bedside. Purpose-built to extend staff capabilities and increase hospital operations efficiency, the VSee telehealth robot includes the latest LiDAR and SLAM technologies for multi-floor autonomous navigation; medical device integration and powerful 30x optical zoom and night cameras for remote physical exams; and lockable drawers for safely delivering instruments, medications and supplies.


## **2. LiDAR and 3D navigation built for busy hallways**


The VSee AI Robot uses the latest LiDAR technology to map your floors and sees in 3D, so it steers around people, beds and equipment and catches low obstacles a flat scan can miss. Staff can send it to a room by name, and it autonomously heads back to its dock when the visit is done. An authorized clinician can always take over driving remotely if needed.


## **3. Meets hospital IT security**


- **Ready before it arrives.** Published network requirements and self-test tools let IT confirm readiness ahead of delivery.


- **Secure, auditable access.** The VSee platform supports MFA and single sign-on, and smart card login records for a clean audit trail.


- **HIPAA compliant, and built to keep you that way.** VSee AI Robot runs on the same HIPAA-compliant VSee platform hospitals already use for video visits, which holds an HHS


[FedRAMP High Authority to Operate](https://vsee.com/fedramp) . Calls are encrypted, providers can be verified with MFA/SSO and/or smart card login, VSee manages the robot’s software security updates outside peak clinical hours, helping ensure your hospital stays HIPAA compliant.


- **Managed for you.** VSee handles mapping, setup and 24/7 monitoring.


- **Fleet view without patient data.** IT can see each robot’s status, battery and location, with no protected health information.


IT team reviewing? Go to the


[Security & IT Trust Center →](https://vsee.com/fedramp)


## **4. Remote physical exams, not just a video call**


VSee AI Robot goes beyond the Ohmni telepresence robot with tools and capabilities to do remote physical exams once the clinician is at the patient’s bedside. A PTZ camera with 30× zoom reads monitors from across the room and can be controlled by the remote physician for close-ups. Infrared lets night teams monitor sleeping patients without turning on the lights. Livestream from a digital stethoscope, otoscope, or other exam camera in real-time to see patients as though in-person.


**Locking drawers:** In addition to medical devices, equip the robot with a smart card reader to verify staff, wristband scanner to confirm patient identity, and a printer in a locking drawer for bedside printing, such as discharge instructions.


## **5. Ready for stroke, virtual sitter, and other hospital programs**


- **Tele-stroke and rapid response.** The specialist sends the robot and starts the exam on arrival, with 30× zoom and night view.


- **Virtual sitter.** A remote sitter can watch over high-risk patients and talk with them through the robot, without a staff member stationed in the room.


- **Rural hospital staffing.** One remote specialist or nurse can cover several units or facilities, with no travel or added headcount.


- **ED overload.** The robot can check patients in, guide them where they need to go and start a virtual triage visit.


- **Patient discharge.** A remote nurse handles discharge education at the bedside and prints instructions on the spot, so floor nurses stay with other patients.


- **Virtual nursing.** Remote nurses handle admissions, education and rounds across the unit.


- **Night coverage.** Night teams reach patients quickly and assess them without waking the room.


Like OhmniCare, the VSee AI Robot supports the virtual care programs you already run. Unlike OhmniCare, VSee also offers


[telehealth carts](https://claude.ai/cowork/cse_018kmKKBx4XDzqojAmeGdSfB#) on the same platform, so you can use robots and carts side by side.


## **6. Support that keeps care going**


VSee’s robot support program currently includes 24/7 coverage, a named account manager, remote diagnostics and advance replacement, so a new robot ships before you return the original. Specific response times are set in your service agreement. If a robot is ever out of service, VSee provides a telehealth cart so your clinicians keep seeing patients.


## **7. Built by a telehealth company trusted by NASA, HHS, McKesson and Tampa General**


The VSee AI Robot runs on the VSee telehealth platform, the same platform behind some of the most demanding virtual care programs in the world.


- **[NASA](https://vsee.com/blog/nasa-chooses-vsee-telemedicine-video-conferencing-iss/) :** VSee built the telehealth system used on the International Space Station and for the Artemis II moon mission, operating in space for more than 11 years.


- **HHS ASPR:** VSee built the national telemedicine disaster response platform for the HHS Administration for Strategic Preparedness and Response (ASPR), used in


[post-cyberattack recovery at Juan F. Luis Hospital in the U.S. Virgin Islands](https://vsee.com/blog/vsee-for-disaster-relief-supporting-critical-hospital-operations-post-cyberattack/) and Kenya’s Ebola outbreak response.


- **McKesson:** VSee workflows helped[cut patient wait times from 11 minutes to 1](https://5691797.fs1.hubspotusercontent-na2.net/hubfs/5691797/Sales-Enablement%20Materials/Use%20Case%20Study%20McKesson-US%20Oncology.pdf) and supported 1,800+ appointments a day.


- **Tampa General Hospital:** One VSee platform runs hospital-at-home, virtual urgent care, kiosks and more, with Epic integration and a single login for providers.


“Hospitals shouldn’t have to worry about whether their robot will still be supported, secure and up to date in three years. We built the VSee AI Robot as a service: we keep it current, we keep it running, and if it ever goes down, we keep your clinicians seeing patients.”


**— Milton Chen, CEO, VSee**


## **8. Frequently asked questions**


**How is the VSee AI Robot different from OhmniCare?** It’s purpose-built for hospitals, with LiDAR and 3D navigation, hospital-grade security, built-in remote exam tools, stroke and virtual sitter workflows, and add-ons like a smart card reader, wristband scanner and printer. VSee also offers telehealth carts on the same platform.


**Is the robot secure enough for hospital IT?** Yes. It runs on VSee’s HIPAA-compliant platform, which holds a FedRAMP High authorization, with role-based permissions and MFA/SSO or smart card login on the robot. See the Security & IT review sheet for details.


**Can a telehealth robot do a remote physical exam?** The VSee AI Robot can. Clinicians use a 30× zoom camera, a digital stethoscope, an exam camera and an otoscope during the visit.


**Can it support tele-stroke and virtual sitter programs?** Yes. For tele-stroke, the specialist sends the robot and starts the exam on arrival. For virtual sitting, a remote sitter watches over high-risk patients and talks with them through the robot.


**Does the robot work at night in dark patient rooms?** Yes. Built-in infrared lets clinicians see the patient without turning on the lights.


**Can it help rural and critical-access hospitals?** Yes. One remote specialist or nurse can cover several units or facilities without travel or added headcount.


**What happens if the robot breaks down?** VSee’s support program currently includes 24/7 coverage, remote diagnostics and advance replacement, plus a loaner telehealth cart so care continues.


**Does it integrate with Epic?** Yes. VSee integrates with Epic, Oracle Health (Cerner) and other major EHRs.
